settlement_source: League governing the game per terms; series metadata lists ESPN and 'Kalshi using information originating from the NCAA'
settlement_variable: Point differential (team minus opponent) over entire game incl. overtime unless otherwise specified, per statistics at game's end
timezone: ET (10:00 AM ET expiration; time periods interpreted in ET)
tie_handling: Tie -> differential 0; 'wins by' positive margin = No; 'exactly 0' = Yes (x.5 strikes make ties moot)
rounding: Strikes at x.5; 'above X' = wins by more than X; no rounding of scores
trading_close_vs_settlement: Listed close_time (e.g. 2026-11-03 for an Oct 31 game) is a bound; expiration moved earlier on determination; latest expiration 15 days after game; 10:00 AM ET; settlement <= day after. can_close_early=1.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Postponed but starts within 48h: stays open, official result
Not started within 48h: last fair price at Exchange sole discretion
Suspended/abandoned before 55 min of play and not resuming within 48h: last fair price (except already-determined markets); after 55 min or league declares final: settle on state at that point
Pre-kickoff forfeit: last fair price; post-start forfeit: league's official result
Home/away reversal or move >48h: last fair price
Market Outcome Review at Kalshi sole discretion
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'wins by over 5.5 points' omits that overtime counts and that postponement window anchors to originally scheduled start
close_time is days after game, not kickoff-based
Series lists ESPN as a source though terms name only the governing league as Source Agency
toxicity_flags: Live score public in-game; stale quotes picked off by faster feeds
Markets may stay open after game ends until determination: resolved-outcome sniping
~2400 open strikes with thin per-strike books
notes: 24h volume ~$818k across ~2429 open markets. NCAA stat-correction behavior not verified.
